text:
tara: Heads-up — need final microcopy for Hosted / Dedicated / Private landing pages by end of week. Want one master page-frame we can adapt per mode (hero + three proof points + primary CTA). Also planning launch posts, webinar hooks, and inbound lead routing. Can people drop quick takes? :mega:

mike: love the master-frame idea. thinking hero should emphasize 'Serve reliably, pay less' instead of product jargon. quick options: 1) 'High-performance inference, anywhere you run it.' 2) 'Production-ready LLM serving — hosted, reserved, or private.' Which tone do we want? short + bold or explicit + trustworthy? :thinking_face:

jess_marketing: short + bold wins for social + launch posts. for the page we can expand under subhead. CTA split: "Try Hosted" for self-serve, "Book Dedicated" for capacity buyers, "Contact Sales" for Private. Need UTMs and form routing to SDR queue for Private. @sara_sdr can you confirm routing fields we need? :link:

sara_sdr: yep — for Private leads we need company size, compliance checkbox, deployment type (VPC/on-prem). tag leads as "enterprise_private" in CRM. calendar booking preferred landing for demos. I'll accept the form if utm_campaign=private_launch. :raised_hands:

ali: for benchmark narrative in the midsection, surface two numbers: median p95 latency (ms) and token cost reduction vs baseline. Example line: 'Typical p95 < 120ms; up to 4x cost savings with batching + cache.' Keep claims verifiable — link to benchmark doc. we'll craft a small methods blurb.

kmiller: product note — be careful with 'pay less' phrasing for Dedicated (committed pricing). maybe 'optimize cost and latency across deployment modes' is safer. Also for Private, call out KMS/HSM & audit logs as top bullets (security-first customers look for those).

mike: got it. hero variants below — please react which works. copy block: 
```
Variant A: Deploy fast. Serve reliably. Choose Hosted, Dedicated, or Private.
Variant B: Production LLM inference — consistent performance across hosted, reserved, and private deployments.
Variant C: High-throughput LLM serving for teams who care about latency, cost, and control.
```

jess_marketing: Variant C is clear but a little long. For launch posts we'll shorten: 'High-throughput LLM serving for teams who care about latency, cost, and control.' — seems shareable. For webinar CTAs: 'See it in action — join our 30-min demo + benchmark walk-through.' We should A/B subject lines: 'How we cut token cost 3x' vs 'Predictable low-latency LLM serving'.

tara: great. next steps: @mike to pick final hero, @ali to draft benchmark snippets & methods, @kmiller to confirm technical callouts, @jess_marketing to write launch post copy and webinar CTAs, @sara_sdr to confirm form fields and routing. deadline: Thurs EOD. I'll assemble final page variants on Friday and push to content repo. :calendar:

deploy-bot: Reminder: calendar invite created for 'Page copy review — Marketing x Product' Fri 10:00am PT. Invite includes recording link and doc.

jess_marketing: one more — can we add a sticky microflow diagram under hero for 'How it works' (1. route by policy 2. cache & batch 3. fallback to variants) — small SVG, helps technical buyers scan.

kmiller: agreed. I can sketch the 3-step microflow and a one-line tooltip per step. will deliver wire copy by Wednesday.

tara: perfect. thanks everyone — tagging this as 'copy-finalize' in the doc. will follow up if any blockers. :rocket:
